eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 2:43 PM on AUG 24, 2023 Effective until 12:43 AM AUG 25, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for the Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix Police Department is looking for Elijah Penunuri, 19 years old male, 6 foot tall, 175 pounds, with brown hair and brown eyes was last wearing a black t shirt, and blue shorts. He was last seen on foot in the area of North 75th Avenue & Indian School Road. Please contact the Phoenix Police Department with any information. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
